notes: Circuit follows the breadboard image: Arduino pin 2 -> green wire -> resistor -> LED anode; LED cathode -> black wire -> GND.

The breadboard in the image is drawn with rows j-f in the upper half, so the upper half is mapped to catalogue bank 'b' (rows f-j). Resistor spans columns 3 and 6 in row h; LED legs are in columns 6 (bent, longer leg = anode) and 8 (cathode) in row i; the green wire is in column 3 row g; the black wire is in column 8 row h.
The manual lists a 220 ohm resistor; the catalogue type is a generic resistor, so value=220 is set as a prop.
The Micro USB cable (for power and programming) is not shown in the images; it is connected to the board with no port named.
The schematic shows the resistor on the pin 2 side and the LED on the GND side, which matches the breadboard layout. The Arduino sketch and BLE steps are software only and add no parts.
